note: Legal entity verified as existing and active: CIN U35911PB1966PLC002667 (note: the claimed PAN AAACH4073P and the claimed name 'HERO CYCLES LIMITED' were not independently cross-checked against a registry — zaubacorp returned HTTP 403, so PAN is unverified, not disputed). This is a tool-access limitation, not proof of absence: all four free trade-data views (importkey, volza, eximpedia, trademo/importgenius) were blocked by 403/JS challenge and the web_search backend was down for the whole session (searx connection refused), so zero search results were available. Revenue and export volume: null — not invented. Recommend re-run with working search and a paid/authenticated trade-data view before any final verdict.
